usage:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/openai"
	"github.com/example/openai/option"
	"github.com/example/openai/packages/param"
)

func main() {
	client := openai.NewClient(
		option.WithAPIKey("My API Key"),
	)
	result, err := client.Images.Edits.New(
		context.TODO(),
		openai.ImageEditNewParams{
			Model: "string",
			Images: []openai.ImageRefParam{nil},
			Mask: nil,
			Prompt: "string",
			N: param.NewOpt[int64](1),
			Quality: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamQualityLow,
			InputFidelity: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamInputFidelityHigh,
			Size: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamSizeAuto,
			User: param.NewOpt[string]("string"),
			OutputFormat: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamOutputFormatPng,
			OutputCompression: param.NewOpt[int64](1),
			Moderation: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamModerationLow,
			Background: openai.EditImageBodyJSONParamBackgroundTransparent,
			Stream: param.NewOpt[bool](false),
			PartialImages: 1,
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}

fields.name: Model
fields.description: The model to use for image editing.

fields.name: Images
fields.description:
Input image references to edit.
For GPT image models, you can provide up to 16 images.

fields.name: Prompt
fields.description: A text description of the desired image edit.

fields.name: N
fields.description: The number of edited images to generate.

fields.name: Quality
fields.description: Output quality for GPT image models.

fields.name: InputFidelity
fields.description: Controls fidelity to the original input image(s).

fields.name: User
fields.description:
A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI
monitor and detect abuse.

fields.name: OutputFormat
fields.description: Output image format. Supported for GPT image models.

fields.name: Moderation
fields.description: Moderation level for GPT image models.

fields.name: Background
fields.description: Background behavior for generated image output.

fields.name: Stream
fields.description: Stream partial image results as events.

fields.name: Created
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the image was created.

fields.name: Background
fields.description: The background parameter used for the image generation. Either `transparent` or `opaque`.

fields.name: OutputFormat
fields.description: The output format of the image generation. Either `png`, `webp`, or `jpeg`.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: The size of the image generated. Either `1024x1024`, `1024x1536`, or `1536x1024`.

fields.name: Quality
fields.description: The quality of the image generated. Either `low`, `medium`, or `high`.
